environmentGaps: Backend ServiceDelivery module is `planned` - intake, submission, requirement, upload, case and history endpoints all decline honestly
Announcement and post-interaction endpoints are `planned`
Event and event-registration endpoints are `planned`
Notification module is `planned` - list, preferences and token registration all decline
No push SDK is wired, deliberately: PushService reports unsupported until an endpoint exists to register a token with
Platform seams (document picker, share sheet, URL launcher) cannot run in widget tests; each is thin glue with the decidable parts unit-tested
No document endpoint exists, so an assistance receipt is a reference rather than a download
The debug APK builds but was not installed or run on a device
ResidentProfile module is `planned` - consent history and every account request decline honestly
No account-controls contract exists yet: AccountControls is the client reading of such a block; wire names unfixed. Nothing is decoded from a guess
TAYTAY_APP_VERSION is not set by any pipeline here, so the version row is absent locally - designed behaviour, not a client-side gap
No DevTools trace or on-device scroll profile: the decode ceiling is reasoned and test-asserted, not measured on hardware
No disk cache, deliberately (D-151): a force-quit on a dead connection shows nothing; within a process everything is kept
Announcements/events/programmes are allow-listed for caching but their modules are planned, so nothing populates those entries yet
No offline submission queue, deliberately: a held request is one whose eligibility and capacity have since moved
Screen-specific copy is still English literals: the l10n architecture is proven on the cross-cutting vocabulary, the rest is a mechanical lift
No real TalkBack/VoiceOver run: semantics are asserted through the tree, not on a device
No right-to-left support, deliberately - neither language this app speaks is RTL
Contrast over remote images is unasserted because nothing draws text over one; a future design needs a scrim and a test first
No TelemetrySink implementation exists, deliberately: no analytics service is named and no endpoint is published
Most of the telemetry catalogue has no call sites yet - defined and tested rather than scattered
The consent prompt has no UI flow because shouldAskForConsent is false in every shipped build
